headline: Sensex drops 500 points as Nifty slips below 25,200 amid profit-taking

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Investors are booking profits following recent rallies in benchmark indices.
Selling pressure in key sectors like Consumer Durables and Metals impacted market momentum.
Major index heavyweights including TCS and Titan Company experienced pullbacks.
Government discussions around tax tweaks to curb derivatives trading weigh on market sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped 500 points while Nifty broke below the 25,200 mark during intra-day trading.
Nifty Consumer Durables sector declined by 3% leading sector losses.
Karnataka Bank announced the appointment of Udaya Kumar Hebbar as its MD & CEO for three years.
TCS and Titan Company traded among the top losers on the benchmark indices.
summary: Indian benchmark indices turned lower on 18 November 2026 as profit-booking took hold after recent gains. The Sensex dropped 500 points with Nifty falling below 25,200, driven by declines in consumer durables and metals. TCS and Titan were top losers, while Karnataka Bank appointed a new MD & CEO.
